steps.observation: You have 30 seconds. Explain the difference between RNA and DNA.

steps.action:
DNA (deoxyribonucleic acid)                         RNA (ribonucleic acid)
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. Sugar          Deoxyribose (lacks one O on C-2′)  Ribose (has OH on C-2′)
2. Strands        Usually double-stranded, helix     Usually single-stranded, many shapes
3. Bases          A, T, C, G                         A, U (uracil), C, G
4. Stability      Chemically stable, long-term store Less stable, suited for short-term tasks
5. Main roles     Permanent genetic blueprint        Messenger (mRNA), adapter (tRNA), catalyst/
                                                     regulator (rRNA, miRNA, etc.)
6. Location       Nucleus (eukaryotes), some organ‐  Nucleus, cytoplasm, ribosomes, viruses
                  elles, some viruses                (and some viruses)
